quests.instruction: I have a long tail for swinging between trees. I live high in the jungle trees. I say "Chatter"! What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the monkey! It has a long tail for swinging between trees and lives high in the jungle trees.
quests.funFact: They are highly social and groom each other to build friendships.
quests.question: Monkey

quests.instruction: I have long jaws and rows of sharp teeth. I live floating quietly in a river. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the crocodile! It has long jaws and rows of sharp teeth and lives floating quietly in a river.
quests.funFact: Did you know? crocodiles have the strongest bite of any animal in the world.
quests.question: Crocodile

quests.instruction: Which animal can run long distances?
quests.hint: This animal lives roaming through the forest.
quests.explanation: Yes! The wolf can run long distances. It has sharp teeth and thick grey fur.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they are the ancestors of all modern domestic dogs.
quests.question: Wolf

quests.instruction: I have scaly skin and a long tail. I live sunbathing on a warm desert rock. I can scurry quickly across rocks. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the lizard! It has scaly skin and a long tail and lives sunbathing on a warm desert rock.
quests.funFact: Did you know? many lizards can detach their tails to escape from predators.
quests.question: Lizard

quests.instruction: One of these animals lives in the jungle. Which one?
quests.hint: Look for the animal with long curved claws and a very calm pace.
quests.explanation: Great job! The sloth lives in the jungle. You can spot it by long curved claws and a very calm pace.
quests.funFact: They spend almost their entire lives hanging upside down in trees.
quests.question: Sloth

quests.instruction: I have round black and white patches. I live munching bamboo in a misty forest. I can climb trees and tumble playfully. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the panda! It has round black and white patches and lives munching bamboo in a misty forest.
quests.funFact: A panda has an extra 'thumb' bone to help it hold bamboo stalks.
quests.question: Panda

quests.instruction: I have five arms shaped like a star. I live resting on the ocean floor. I can creep slowly along the seabed. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the starfish! It has five arms shaped like a star and lives resting on the ocean floor.
quests.funFact: Did you know? starfish can actually regrow lost arms.
quests.question: Starfish

quests.instruction: I have two pairs of colorful, patterned wings. I live fluttering over garden flowers. I can flutter and fly. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the butterfly! It has two pairs of colorful, patterned wings and lives fluttering over garden flowers.
quests.funFact: They undergo a complete metamorphosis from caterpillar to butterfly.
quests.question: Butterfly

quests.instruction: I have a tiny body and a long thin beak. I live darting between bright garden flowers. I say "Hum"! What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the hummingbird! It has a tiny body and a long thin beak and lives darting between bright garden flowers.
quests.funFact: Their wings can beat up to 80 times per second.
quests.question: Hummingbird

quests.instruction: I have sharp talons and amazing eyesight. I live soaring high above the mountains. I say "Screech"! What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the eagle! It has sharp talons and amazing eyesight and lives soaring high above the mountains.
quests.funFact: An eagle can dive at speeds of up to 100 miles per hour.
quests.question: Eagle

quests.instruction: I have a tiny body and super strong legs. I live marching through the garden. I can march in a busy line. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the ant! It has a tiny body and super strong legs and lives marching through the garden.
quests.funFact: Did you know? ants can carry objects up to 50 times their own body weight.
quests.question: Ant

quests.instruction: I have a tiny body and a long thin beak. I live darting between bright garden flowers. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the hummingbird! It has a tiny body and a long thin beak and lives darting between bright garden flowers.
quests.funFact: They have the highest metabolism of any warm-blooded animal.
quests.question: Hummingbird

quests.instruction: I have a curly, spiral-shaped shell. I live inching along a garden leaf. I can glide slowly on a trail of slime. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the snail! It has a curly, spiral-shaped shell and lives inching along a garden leaf.
quests.funFact: They have thousands of microscopic teeth on their tongue.
quests.question: Snail

quests.instruction: Which animal can hop in big leaps?
quests.hint: This animal lives hopping across the land in Australia.
quests.explanation: Yes! The kangaroo can hop in big leaps. It has strong back legs and a built-in baby pouch.
quests.funFact: A kangaroo can jump up to 3 times its own height.
quests.question: Kangaroo

quests.instruction: I have a see-through, umbrella-shaped body. I live drifting through the ocean water. I can pulse and drift with the current. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the jellyfish! It has a see-through, umbrella-shaped body and lives drifting through the ocean water.
quests.funFact: Did you know? jellyfish have no brain, heart, or bones, and are mostly made of water.
quests.question: Jellyfish

quests.instruction: I have big round eyes and long jumping legs. I live in a splashy pond. I say "Ribbit"! What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the frog! It has big round eyes and long jumping legs and lives in a splashy pond.
quests.funFact: Frogs completely close their eyes when they swallow food.
quests.question: Frog

quests.instruction: I have bright, colorful tail feathers. I live in a farmyard at sunrise. I say "Cock-a-doodle-doo"! What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the rooster! It has bright, colorful tail feathers and lives in a farmyard at sunrise.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they crow to claim their territory and protect the flock.
quests.question: Rooster

quests.instruction: I have round fuzzy ears and a big black nose. I live resting in a eucalyptus tree in Australia. I can climb slowly and cling to branches. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the koala! It has round fuzzy ears and a big black nose and lives resting in a eucalyptus tree in Australia.
quests.funFact: Koalas get almost all their water from the leaves they eat.
quests.question: Koala

quests.instruction: Which animal has a tiny body and a long thin beak?
quests.hint: This animal usually lives darting between bright garden flowers.
quests.explanation: That's right! The hummingbird has a tiny body and a long thin beak. It says "Hum".
quests.funFact: A hummingbird can consume half its body weight in nectar every day.
quests.question: Hummingbird

quests.instruction: I have a long body with no legs at all. I live slithering through the grass. I say "Hiss"! What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the snake! It has a long body with no legs at all and lives slithering through the grass.
quests.funFact: Snakes swallow their food completely whole.
quests.question: Snake

quests.instruction: I have orange fur with black stripes. I live prowling through the jungle. I can run and pounce. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the tiger! It has orange fur with black stripes and lives prowling through the jungle.
quests.funFact: Tigers are excellent swimmers and actually enjoy the water.
quests.question: Tiger

quests.instruction: Which animal can waddle, then curl into a tight ball?
quests.hint: This animal lives rustling through a garden at night.
quests.explanation: Yes! The hedgehog can waddle, then curl into a tight ball. It has hundreds of sharp little spines.
quests.funFact: They rely on hearing and smell because their eyesight is poor.
quests.question: Hedgehog

quests.instruction: I have a hard round shell on the back. I live paddling in a calm pond. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the turtle! It has a hard round shell on the back and lives paddling in a calm pond.
quests.funFact: A turtle's shell is actually part of its skeleton, made of 50 bones.
quests.question: Turtle

quests.instruction: I have long curved claws and a very calm pace. I live hanging from a rainforest branch. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the sloth! It has long curved claws and a very calm pace and lives hanging from a rainforest branch.
quests.funFact: A sloth's stomach has four compartments and takes up to a month to digest a meal.
quests.question: Sloth

quests.instruction: I have black and yellow stripes and tiny wings. I live buzzing around flowers in a garden. I say "Buzz"! What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the bee! It has black and yellow stripes and tiny wings and lives buzzing around flowers in a garden.
quests.funFact: Only female worker bees can sting.
quests.question: Bee

quests.instruction: Can you find the animal that lives in the forest?
quests.hint: Look for the animal with round black and white patches.
quests.explanation: Great job! The panda lives in the forest. You can spot it by round black and white patches.
quests.funFact: Baby pandas are incredibly tiny, about the size of a stick of butter.
quests.question: Panda

quests.instruction: I have bright pink feathers and long thin legs. I live wading in a shallow, pink-tinted lake. I can wade and stand on one leg. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the flamingo! It has bright pink feathers and long thin legs and lives wading in a shallow, pink-tinted lake.
quests.funFact: A flock of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
quests.question: Flamingo

quests.instruction: I have long curved claws and a very calm pace. I live hanging from a rainforest branch. I can move extremely slowly through the trees. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the sloth! It has long curved claws and a very calm pace and lives hanging from a rainforest branch.
quests.funFact: Despite being slow on land, sloths are surprisingly excellent swimmers.
quests.question: Sloth

quests.instruction: I have dry, bumpy skin. I live hopping through a damp garden. I say "Croak"! What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the toad! It has dry, bumpy skin and lives hopping through a damp garden.
quests.funFact: Unlike frogs, toads spend most of their lives on dry land.
quests.question: Toad

quests.instruction: I have a curly tail and a round pink nose. I live on a muddy farm. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the pig! It has a curly tail and a round pink nose and lives on a muddy farm.
quests.funFact: Pigs are highly intelligent and can solve complex puzzles.
quests.question: Pig
